_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'We are the world’s second largest cruise company operating 38 ships in the cruise vacation industry with approximately 84,050 berths as of December 31, 2009'; 'We compete principally on the basis of quality of ships, quality of service, variety of itineraries, choice of destinations and price'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic and business conditions' (its own FY2009 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'We are the world’s second largest cruise company operating 38 ships in the cruise vacation industry with approximately 84,050 berths as of December 31, 2009'; 'We compete principally on the basis of quality of ships, quality of service, variety of itineraries, choice of destinations and price'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic and business conditions' (its own FY2009 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.84x; +37% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.82; conservative 2yr +75%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -72.0%/yr (worst year FY00-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +19.4%/yr (Q3 cc guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +19.4%/yr (FY00-FY09 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +46.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY00-FY09); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2010-08-27) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.84x (92.1% downside to Bear $2 / +109.6% upside to Bull $53) | Adj composite 3.55 vs market 1.73: gap +1.82 [UNDERVALUED] | +37% above the EPP floor $18 (8x FY10E $2.30) | Conservative 2-yr case: +75.4% total (+37.7%/yr) | At 11.0x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $33 sits at or below the BASE case; Net Yields +4.9% in Q2 2010, forward net revenue +20.59% (Q3 2010 net revenue guide at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
